# anthropic_api_keys (Data Source)

Lists API keys in the organization through the Admin API, with optional filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_api_keys" "production" {
  workspace_id = anthropic_workspace.production.id
}

output "never_expiring_api_keys" {
  value = [
    for key in data.anthropic_api_keys.production.api_keys :
    key.name
    if key.expires_at == null
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `created_by_user_id` (String) Filter by the ID of the User who created the key.
- `status` (String) Filter by API key status: `active`, `inactive`, `archived` or `expired`.
- `workspace_id` (String) Filter by workspace ID.

### Read-Only

- `api_keys` (Attributes List) The matching API keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_keys))
- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source, derived from the configured filters.

<a id="nestedatt--api_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api_keys`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the API key was created.
- `created_by` (Attributes) The actor that created the API key. Null for a legacy, workload-identity-federated, or system-created key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_keys--created_by))
- `expires_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the API key expires. Null when the key never expires.
- `id` (String) ID of the API key.
- `name` (String) Name of the API key.
- `partial_key_hint` (String) Partially redacted hint for the API key.
- `principal` (Attributes) The principal the API key acts as. Null when the key is not bound to a principal. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_keys--principal))
- `scope` (Attributes) Where the API key belongs: its workspace, or the organization for a principal-bound key with no workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_keys--scope))
- `status` (String) Status of the API key.

<a id="nestedatt--api_keys--created_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api_keys.created_by`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) ID of the actor that created the API key.
- `type` (String) Type of the actor that created the API key: `user` or `service_account`.


<a id="nestedatt--api_keys--principal"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api_keys.principal`

Read-Only:

- `service_account_id` (String) ID of the Service Account the API key acts as. Null unless `type` is `service_account_actor`.
- `type` (String) Principal type: `user_actor` or `service_account_actor`.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the User the API key acts as. Null unless `type` is `user_actor`.


<a id="nestedatt--api_keys--scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api_keys.scope`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Scope type: `organization` or `workspace`.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the workspace the API key belongs to. Null for the `organization` scope.
